title: 環境土木工学設計Ⅰ
subtitle: Design in Civil and Environmental Engineering I
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) systematically understand the curriculum studied in the undergraduate and graduate programs of the dept of civil and environmental engineering.
(2) be conscious of learning objectives and set targets as an engineer.
(3) understand the scheme of the construction industry.
(4) understand the history of civil engineering from the past to the future.
(5) design their own career paths, including graduate school.
advice:
This is a basic course in the study of civil and environmental engineering. We will cover the following topics:

1. Understanding the content areas and flow of subjects studied in the department of civil and environmental engineering
2. Understanding what civil engineering entails
3. Understanding trends of civil engineering from the past to the future
4. Understanding civil engineering technologies applied in the development of the Hokuriku region, the whole country of Japan, Asian nations, and the world, and the spirit of the engineers engaged in that development

Students are required to actively participate in class.

This learning is useful for all subjects.
requiredKnowledge: Students must have attended Basic Style for Study A and Introduction to Engineering (Civil Environmental Engineering) lectures.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is a basic course in the study of civil and environmental engineering. We will cover the following topics:

1. Understanding the content areas and flow of subjects studied in the department of civil and environmental engineering
2. Understanding what civil engineering entails
3. Understanding trends of civil engineering from the past to the future
4. Understanding civil engineering technologies applied in the development of the Hokuriku region, the whole country of Japan, Asian nations, and the world, and the spirit of the engineers engaged in that development

Students are required to actively participate in class.

This learning is useful for all subjects.
